name: dsa-tracker
description: DSA study-plan tracker: React + Express + SQL Server

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.test: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server test
scripts.app:start: npm run build && pm2 startOrReload ecosystem.config.js --update-env
